summary.overview: Customer called regarding an overdue balance of £450. Customer agreed to pay £225 today and £225 on November 15th.
action_items: Set payment plan reminder for November 15th

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Hi David, calling about the £450 arrears on your account.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Yeah, I lost my shifts last week. I can't do the full £450.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Could you manage half today—£225—and £225 on November 15th?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: No, I don't get paid until November 1st. I can pay £150 on November 1st, and we can review the rest on November 15th. Nothing today.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Okay, I'll note £150 for November 1st and a follow-up call on the 15th.

summary.overview: Agent contacted customer about missed October vehicle finance payment of £310. Customer refused to pay and stated she will call back on Friday October 24th with a debit card.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Hello Elena, I'm calling from Advantage Finance regarding the missed £310 payment from October 10th.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Look, I'm actually in the hospital right now recovering from surgery. I haven't been able to work or check my mail.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I'm sorry to hear that. Do you know when you'll be discharged?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Not until next week. Can you freeze the account for 30 days so I don't get late fees while I'm admitted?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Yes, I will apply a 30-day medical breathing space hold on your account today and send a confirmation email. No payments will be requested until November 20th.

summary.overview: Customer called to clear £180 arrears balance in full using a Visa debit card ending in 4491 and requested moving future direct debit dates from the 1st to the 28th of each month.
action_items: Confirm £180 payment receipt sent via SMS
Update monthly Direct Debit date to the 28th

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Hi, I missed my £180 payment on the 1st because my employer changed our payday to the 27th.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: No problem Tom, we can clear the £180 today and move your future Direct Debit to the 28th so it lines up with your new payday.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Yes please. Put the £180 on my Visa ending 4491 on file, and move the monthly date to the 28th.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Done. The £180 has gone through, I've sent an SMS receipt, and your next Direct Debit will run on the 28th of November.
